title: bindings
summary: MSUI runs rebindable keyboard and pointer inputs through canonical ALT-CTRL-SHIFT chords with global exact-match precedence, the reference's single leftmost-modifier fallback, Super rejection, and base-key Held latches that survive modifier changes and clear cleanly for typing. Account and GUID-keyed character sets follow the reference create-copy and confirmed load-account-before-delete lifecycle. The visible registry follows Benilla's category ladder, one unified MultiActionBar header, and the Raid Targeting block. The production dispatcher covers physical-secondary movement, NumLock/Button4 autorun, X sit/stand, follow target, T attack target, chat commands, camera/minimap zoom and Toggle Minimap, audio controls, independent nameplate modes, direct Social panes, current enemy scanning, self/party/pet targeting, pet attack, and raid markers. The Action Bar tail now includes Ctrl-F1..F10 Shapeshift Button commands routed through the existing stance law, Ctrl-1..Ctrl-0 Secondary Action Button commands armed on key-down and fired through the real pet action on key-up, plus the unbound Toggle Action Bar Lock command and matching Interface option. Locking suppresses main/pet drag-start and receive-drag while retaining vanilla's Shift-click pickup escape hatch. Protected bag/action-bar presentation is unchanged.

openItems.text: No modifier chords: BindingPair holds bare Silk Key values - SHIFT-/CTRL-/ALT- combinations cannot be bound, and there is no exact-modifier-match rule distinguishing a bare binding from a chorded one.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: BindingChordLaw owns canonical ALT-CTRL-SHIFT token parsing/emission, modifier exclusion and the one-step ALT then CTRL then SHIFT fallback. GameLoop.Bindings persists chord strings, migrates old bare enum names, globally prefers any exact chord before fallback, rejects Super, and latches resolved commands on the base-key edge until release; typing clears latches while retaining physical state. Focused chord and Alt-Z checks pass.

openItems.text: Codec, persistence/source fences, exact-first/fallback dispatch, Held latches, Super rejection, capture and Alt-Z/sheath regressions pass. Needs owner-run live acceptance for movement/action/panel chords, modifier-release ordering, chat focus, conflict steals and a save/reload round trip.
No per-character binding set: one keybindings.json for everything; the reference's account-vs-character split (and the confirmed switch that deletes the character file) has no counterpart.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Account bindings remain in keybindings.json; character sets use a stable LocalPlayerGuid-keyed file. Enabling immediately copies/persists the live set. Confirmed disabling loads account bindings before deleting the character file and saves the unchanged account set. The shared StaticPopup owns the destructive confirmation and focused clinical checks pass.

openItems.text: Rebindable command coverage remains narrower than current Benilla's honest registry. Host, social, audio, minimap, self/party/pet targeting, pet attack, multibar and raid-marker commands are present. Remaining unported commands are the shapeshift and bonus/pet action-button rows plus Toggle Action Bar Lock; bag/action-bar presentation is protected and must not be changed while adding their command seams.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Added the full Action Bar registry tail: Ctrl-F1..F10 invokes visible stance buttons through ActivateStanceSpell; Ctrl-1..Ctrl-0 uses the real pet actions with the reference down/up latch; Toggle Action Bar Lock is unbound and flips the persisted Interface option. ActionBarLockLaw gates only main/pet drag-start and receive-drag, leaving Shift-click pickup intact. Focused ActionBarBindingTail, KeyBindingRegistry and full interface suites pass without changing bar geometry or art.

openItems.text: Live-verify Enter, slash and reply edit-box focus/prefill; NumLock and Button4 autorun toggling, W/S and both-button cancellation, root/taxi loss, wire movement and walk interaction; rebind/steal camera wheel zoom including consecutive notches and free-view flight; arrow secondaries; numpad jump; and persistence/conflict feedback in Key Bindings.
Live-verify V, Shift-V and Ctrl-V exact-first command dispatch, independent enemy/friendly mode state, all-toggle behavior, custom rebind/conflict stealing, persistence and typing suppression.

Focused StandState, Minimap, Chat, AutoFollow and BindingChord checks plus the full interface suite pass. Live-verify X posture toggle and packet echo; T start/stop/no-target acquisition; custom Follow Target; PageUp/PageDown/Shift-PageDown; and numpad minimap zoom indoors/outdoors, including rebind/conflict persistence and typing gates.

Focused TargetCycle and full interface checks pass. Live-verify Tab screen-priority selection, off-screen fallback, fighting-me priority, repeated four-second walk/wrap, clicked-target continuation, Shift-Tab reverse history, dead/critter/range rejection, Ctrl-Tab ownership, typing suppression, custom rebind/conflict persistence and attack re-point behavior.

Focused SocialTabBindings and full interface checks pass. Live-bind and verify Toggle Friends Pane, Toggle Who Pane and Toggle Guild Pane: same-pane close, cross-pane switch, Friends/Who refresh, guildless refusal, typing suppression, conflict stealing and save/reload persistence.

Focused AudioBindings and full interface checks pass. Live-verify Ctrl-M music, Ctrl-S master sound, Ctrl-=/Ctrl-- tenth-step clamping, mixer response, exact-first coexistence with bare M/S/-/= commands, typing suppression, custom rebind/conflict persistence and settings save/reload.
Focused MinimapBinding and full interface checks pass. Live-bind Toggle Minimap and verify collapse/reopen state, open/close sounds, typing suppression, conflict stealing and save/reload persistence.

Focused TargetBindings and full interface checks pass. Live-verify F1/F2-F5 primary-then-pet toggles, Shift-F1/F2-F5 direct pet targeting, absent-token no-ops, Shift-T attack/stop behavior, unbound raid-marker assignment/toggle/clear, typing suppression, conflict stealing and save/reload persistence.

Focused ActionBarBindingTail, KeyBindingRegistry and full interface suites pass. Live-verify Ctrl-F1..F10 stance activation/cancellation/visibility, Ctrl-1..Ctrl-0 pet pressed-state and release firing, rebind/conflict/typing behavior, Toggle Action Bar Lock plus Options Cancel/Okay/Defaults/preset persistence, locked main/pet drag refusal, locked receive-drag payload retention, and the Shift-click pickup escape hatch.
